'''''Vision of the Future''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Timothy Zahn]]. It is the sequel to ''[[Specter of the Past]]'' ([[1997]]) and the second volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]''. It was first published in hardcover by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[September]] [[1998]].
